lines.text: HARPER stands frozen in the mahogany library, staring at the legal trust file naming Cole as the billionaire CEO.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Harper, let me explain why I had to hide my identity as the Whitmore shipping heir until the will was read.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: You lied to a broke 24-year-old night-shift nurse just to use me for a contract marriage, Cole!
JAKE watches through the glass doors, smirking as he sips scotch and celebrates his mother Diane's deadly scheme.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: My 58-year-old board member status is secure now that 81-year-old Evelyn is dead and buried.
HARPER yanks her wedding ring off her finger and throws it hard against the stone fireplace.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: My grandmother Evelyn knew about the inheritance clause, but my feelings for you were real!

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: My 17-year-old sister Mia is still recovering from her heart surgery, and you built our entire life on a throne of lies.
COLE reaches out his hand, but Harper backs away toward the heavy oak doors, her eyes filled with tears.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Stay away from me, Cole Hayes, or whatever your real name is.
JAKE steps into the doorway, blocking her exit with a sinister smile and a new legal document.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: If you want to leave him, Harper, sign these papers and let me be the one who saves you.
